scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,green "uv run --directory apps/api uvicorn --app-dir src low_altitude_poc_api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "pnpm --filter @low-altitude/web dev"
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @low-altitude/web format:check && uv run --directory apps/api --cache-dir /private/tmp/low-altitude-uv-cache ruff format --check
scripts.lint: pnpm typecheck && uv run --directory apps/api --cache-dir /private/tmp/low-altitude-uv-cache ruff check
scripts.infer:demo: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --directory apps/api python -m low_altitude_poc_api.inference_worker --video ../../tools/fixtures/suspected-fire.mp4 --source-time 2026-09-03T06:30:05Z --longitude 106.6282 --latitude 26.6467 --api-url http://127.0.0.1:8000
scripts.evaluate:ai: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --directory apps/api python -m low_altitude_poc_api.evaluation_runner --manifest ../../tools/evaluation/v1/manifest.json --api-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --token $LOW_ALTITUDE_INFERENCE_TOKEN
